messages:
maria (docs): quick heads-up — i opened a tiny PR to add a compact "provisioning playbook" focused on Dedicated onboarding: checklist, the recommended terraform snippet location, an autoscale-v2 migration note, and short SDK examples (py + go). link-check and markdown-lint are failing. can someone triage the links and the lint nits? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4412 (branch: docs/playbook-mini)

sam (infra): on it. link-check shows two 404s: the old /terraform/snippets page and an ancient scalepolicy overview. i can fix the terraform link to point to /handbook/infra/terraform-reserved-pools. which scalepolicy URL did you reference?

maria (docs): thanks. the scalepolicy link points to /docs/autoscale/legacy-scalepolicy which is gone. the intent is to point readers at the v2 guidance. if we can redirect or point to /guides/autoscale/v2 that works.

jordan (eng): i pulled the PR locally — markdown-lint complains because code fences lack language tags and there
re a few long lines. also the python snippet uses the old client method name (it should be .provision_dedicated now). i'll push a tiny patch to update that.

carla (platform): i'll add a redirect for the old scalepolicy path to /guides/autoscale/v2 and leave a short note there about cooldown semantics. alex, can you confirm the suggested smoke test steps?

alex (sre): yep. for the migration checklist please include a step: "validate cooldown behavior with a reserved pool + v2 policy (cooldown >= 30s)." add the smoke script link (we keep it in infra/test-scripts/provision_smoke.sh). also add a note: "expect temporary scaling differences during transition."

maria (docs): perfect — can someone also tighten the SDK examples to be two lines each? readers like tiny, copiable examples. current ones are a bit verbose. e.g. short py + go variants.

sam (infra): here's a minimal python example that matches the latest client API (paste as a ```python block):

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.provision_dedicated(tenant_label="team-ops", isolation="isolated")
```

sam (infra): and a minimal Go example: 

```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
client := sdk.New()
client.ProvisionDedicated("team-ops", "isolated")
```

jordan (eng): thanks — i updated the python import & method and added language labels to code fences. also wrapped long lines in the playbook so markdown-lint should be happy.

carla (platform): redirect for legacy scalepolicy is live. i updated the terraform link to the handbook path. can someone re-run link-check?

docs-bot: PR #4412 status update \u2014 checks: link-check (running), lint (running), build (pending)

sam (infra): re-run finished — link-check passed. lint has a single nit: heading hierarchy (we prefer H3 for steps under quick-checklist). i'll push that tiny tweak.

maria (docs): done — adjusted headings and added alex's smoke test line to the migration checklist. also added a one-line note about tenant_label formatting: "kebab-case, <=32 chars."

sam (infra): lint & link-check now green. approving. :+1:

jordan (eng): small follow-up: we should migrate the two SDK snippets into the quickstart templates repo so examples stay synchronized. i'll file a follow-up issue after merge.

maria (docs): merging once the build passes. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!

docs-bot: PR #4412 merged by maria (docs) \u2014 checks all passed.

carla (platform): added a short paragraph in the playbook on choosing "isolated" vs "shared": "use isolated for compliance or guaranteed tenancy; use shared when you want lower cost and higher consolidation."

maria (docs): lovely. closing the loop — i'll open the follow-up issue to port snippets into quickstart templates tomorrow. thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
